episode.title: Tenochtitlan Was Larger Than Any City In Spain

synopsis: When Spanish forces arrived in 1519, the Aztec capital of Tenochtitlan was an island metropolis larger than any city in Spain.

title_card.title: Tenochtitlan was a city on a lake.
title_card.subtitle: It was larger than any city in Spain in 1519.

caption:
When the Spanish arrived, the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan was a city on a lake, larger than any city in Spain.

Founded around 1325 in the Valley of Mexico, the grand island capital connected to the mainland through massive stone causeways. By 1519, over 200,000 residents navigated its clean canals and vibrant markets daily.
